description: This Java source file defines the class PackageClassConverter, which handles conversion and reference resolution for PsiClass elements within Android XML manifest files, including class name resolution, inheritance search, and reference binding.

classes.name: PackageClassConverter
classes.description: A converter class for resolving and referencing PsiClass elements in Android manifest files, supporting class name conversion, inheritance search, and reference binding.

classes.name: MyReference
classes.description: An inner class extending PsiReferenceBase, implementing reference resolution, variant suggestions, and binding logic for class and package references within XML attributes.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Returns an empty collection of variants for code completion.

methods.description: Converts a string representation of a class name into a PsiClass object, resolving within the current module and scope.

methods.description: Creates PsiReference objects for class name attributes, enabling navigation and refactoring.

methods.name: getQualifiedName
methods.description: Recursively constructs the qualified name of a PsiClass, including inner classes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Recursively constructs the inner class name with '$' separators.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a PsiClass to its string representation relative to the package context.

methods.name: getPackageName

methods.name: classToString
